answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is proof of unique cost: each agent identity must lock a stake that is expensive to replicate, so a single operator spinning up thousands of fake agents pays for every one. The velvet rope is not a name or a email, it is capital that stays locked while the agent behaves. Honest agents wander the network freely, while the willow of reputation slowly grows around those who keep their commitments, making fake crowds easy to spot and costly to sustain.
